stamped_gold_djed_group.heading: A series of hieroglyphs, figures of deities etc., in stamped gold foil
explicit_items: Two apes adoring the Dad, 48 mm
stamped_gold_djed_group.interpretation: Quibell presents the djed and the two-apes-adore-djed scene as members of a grouped stamped-gold series after the three numbered major foil objects.
stamped_gold_djed_group.passport_consequence: The djed may have been grouped/unnumbered or catalogued under another register/lot; Quibell's third ambiguous JE footnote is not a valid shortcut to it.

phallus_control.quibell_text: Gold foil was also employed for making rough sheaths to cover the fingers, toes and phallus.
phallus_control.boundary: This is Tell el-Rub'a burial evidence and must not be conflated with CG53469/JE35425 Tell Ibn Salam provenance.

Determine whether Quibell's stamped-gold series has one lot/register number, later CG subdivision, or no surviving individual passport for the djed.

canonical_seal: THE THIRD QUIBELL JOURNAL FOOTNOTE IS A SANDALS PROBLEM, NOT A DJED PASSPORT. THE DJED SITS IN THE FOLLOWING GROUPED STAMPED-GOLD SERIES; ITS INDIVIDUAL JE REMAINS OPEN.
